name: Confirm Menu Circle Exit
author: yamyi (ported from YuGiOhForbiddenMemoriesRecomp)
description: Circle on the mode-select wheel asks before dropping to the title screen, instead of leaving at once.

settings.label: Default answer
settings.description: Which answer the prompt opens on. NO means a second stray press cannot exit.

settings.label: Title colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for RETURN TO TITLE?. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 7. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.

settings.label: Selected answer colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for the answer currently chosen. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 7. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.

settings.label: Other answer colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for the answer not chosen. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 7. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.

settings.label: OK label colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for the OK label beside the cross button. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 7. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.

settings.label: CANCEL label colour
settings.description: Colour ramp for the CANCEL label beside the circle button. The game's own text colour ramps, 0 to 7. 0 is white and 1 the gold it titles with; the others are the rest of its palette.
